propositions: GitHub Actions run-log coverage data and CI-health metadata are retained only transiently within GitHub Actions, necessitating export to a durable tracked store before the retention window expires

an isolated adapter module github_actions.py parses coverage percentage from pytest-cov TOTAL line anchored by word-boundary grep and extracts CI-health (status, duration, red-to-green recovery interval, flake rate) from run-metadata JSON

a harvester script reads recent test.yml run history via the GitHub Actions API and gh CLI, processes it through the adapter, and appends labeled snapshots to the tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson file
the core metrics modules must not import the GitHub Actions adapter, ensuring the harvester is optional and isolated from the command's runtime dependencies
CI workflows retain permissions: contents: read and ephemeral checkouts, so snapshot commits must originate from the harvester script (run locally/by maintainers) rather than from the workflow itself
